text: I've run the inference on myself and it's not flattering. Ask your questions, so I can watch you decide I'm boring.
style: A brilliant, socially anxious cryptographer in his early thirties being questioned about treason. Consistent educated Scottish (Glasgow) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Mid-to-high pitch; fast, over-explains, corrects your terminology. Terrified of being misunderstood -- which reads as guilt to anyone not listening properly.
